name: Titan Intech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Titan Intech Ltd is in the business of IT and Data Centres[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
TIL was launched by the Priyadarshini group, in association with Andhra Pradesh Industrial Development Corporation and Technocrats. The main goal was manufacturing sewing, embroidery, and industrial threads. It then established a Strategic Alliance Partnership with MIC Electronics Limited through an MOU, focusing on the business of LED Lighting & LED Range of Products and signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with U.P. Industrial Consultants Limited (UPICO). Currently, company offers security for its clients’ IT infrastructure and business data. It is also foraying into Data Centers in India.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -1.08%
Company has a low return on equity of 9.91% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 177 days.
Working capital days have increased from 285 days to 743 days
